title: فهرست · Fihrist
description: Fihrist data file — the index of pharmacy and insurance tools.
markdownDescription:
## فهرست · Fihrist

The index of pharmacy and insurance tools.

| Key | Role |
|:--|:--|
| `groups` | Tabs shown across the top |
| `tools` | One row per tool, with a single `url` or a set of `variants` |

> Bump **`revision`** after every edit so open copies pick up the change.

defaultSnippets.label: New Fihrist file
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A complete starter file with one group and one tool.

$schema.markdownDescription: Links this file to its schema for editor completion, hovers and validation.

revision.title: Revision · المراجعة
revision.markdownDescription:
### Revision · المراجعة

Whole number that **must go up** with every edit.

When the app finds a served `fihrist.json` with a higher revision than the copy it holds, it shows **Update available · Apply**.

---
رقم يزيد مع كل تعديل.
revision.errorMessage: Revision must be a whole number, 1 or higher.

updated.title: Updated · آخر تحديث
updated.markdownDescription:
### Updated · آخر تحديث

Date of the last edit, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

groups.title: Groups · التصنيفات
groups.markdownDescription:
### Groups · التصنيفات

One tab per group, in this order. Every tool points at a group through its `group` key.

tools.title: Tools · الأدوات
tools.markdownDescription:
### Tools · الأدوات

One row per tool, in this order. Each tool has **either** a single `url` **or** a list of `variants`.

Type `{` inside the array to pick a ready-made tool.

slug.patternErrorMessage: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, for example "drug-list".

date.patternErrorMessage: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-10-07".

url.patternErrorMessage: Must be a full http(s) link with no spaces, for example "https://tool.vercel.app/".

pigment.errorMessage: Pick one of: indigo, verdigris, madder, orpiment, lapis, malachite, tyrian, bone.

icon.title: Icon · الأيقونة
icon.markdownDescription:
### Icon · الأيقونة

Glyph shown on the group's tab.
icon.errorMessage: Pick one of: layers, calc, flask, printer, star, box.

id.markdownDescription:
### Group id

Unique key. Tools point here through `group`.

aliases.title: Aliases · أسماء بديلة
aliases.markdownDescription:
### Aliases · أسماء بديلة

Extra words that should find this tool: Franco-Arabic spellings, old names, abbreviations, Arabic synonyms.

Search already ignores tashkeel, hamza forms and taa marbuta, so `أنماط` and `انماط` match each other.

defaultSnippets.label: Variant
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Another version of the same tool.

id.markdownDescription:
### Variant id

Unique inside this tool. The app remembers the last variant you opened by this id.

url.markdownDescription:
### Link · الرابط

Where this variant opens.

dar.markdownDescription: Optional **Arabic** description shown when this variant is selected.

den.markdownDescription: Optional **English** description shown when this variant is selected.

closed.markdownDescription: Mark this variant as closed. It stays listed but dimmed.

defaultSnippets.label: Tool · single link
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A tool that opens one link.

defaultSnippets.label: Tool · with variants
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A tool with several versions. `def` picks the one that opens by default.

id.markdownDescription:
### Tool id

Unique key. Used for pins, history and the deep link `index.html#tool-id`.

group.markdownDescription:
### Group · التصنيف

The `id` of one of the entries in `groups`.

dar.markdownDescription:
### Description · الوصف

One short line in **Arabic**.

since.markdownDescription:
### Since · تاريخ الإضافة

Date the tool was added. Shows a **New · جديد** flag for 21 days.

closed.markdownDescription:
### Closed · مغلق

Keeps the tool listed with a **Closed** pill and a dimmed title.

url.markdownDescription:
### Link · الرابط

Where the tool opens. Use this **or** `variants`, not both.

def.markdownDescription:
### Default variant · النسخة الافتراضية

Zero-based position in `variants` of the version that opens by default.
def.errorMessage: def is a position in variants: 0, 1, 2…

variants.title: Variants · النسخ
variants.markdownDescription:
### Variants · النسخ

Versions of the same tool. Use this **or** `url`, not both.

url.errorMessage: This tool has variants, so the link belongs on each variant. Remove "url".

def.errorMessage: "def" only applies to tools with variants.
